capabilities: copy an image to the clipboard from the right-click context menu
copy an image on mobile via a one-second long press
extras: Includes manual installation steps through the community plugin browser; mobile usage requires holding the image still for about one second.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to copy an embedded or displayed image directly to the clipboard.
summary: Adds a right-click context-menu action that copies an image in a note to the clipboard, on desktop via right-click and on mobile via long-press.
